i really, really enjoyed this.. if it had an english translation, i would gladly pay again to read it. the storyline was really interesting, and the language barrier did me dirty xd. lets go to the actual review.

i would give the plot full points, this is what kept me reading until the end, the author just gave the right amount of information to keep you reading. a necromancer and and divine power user was something new to me, the contrast between the two was thrilling, they had similar goals but both approached it in very different yet similar ways; which made the love story pop out even better.
